text.p: Tropical cyclone 08B, with winds of 50 mph, is located in the Bay of Bengal near 14N/86.0E and is moving off to the west at 5 mph. This system will threaten shipping during the next 24-36 hours as it tracks towards the coast. Landfall is expected in extreme southern Andhra Pradesh India, near the boarder with Tamil Nadu. Winds of 40-45 mph are expected near landfall along with a storm surge. Rains will cause flooding and possible mudslides as the system moves inland later in the period.
Tropical cyclone 08s in the southwest Indian Ocean will threaten shipping during the next 48 hours. Winds are about 30 mph at this time but they may reach 55-60 mph in 48 hours.
THERE ARE NO FURTHER EMERGENCY STATEMENTS AT THIS TIME
